name: West Ridge
approach: All approaches to Martin Peak begin at Holden Village: take the Lake Chelan ferry (Chelan Boat Company's Lady of the Lake II or Lady Express) from Chelan or Fields Point Landing to Lucerne Landing, then the Holden Village shuttle bus up an 11-mile gravel road (12 switchbacks) into Holden Village. From Holden, follow the Railroad Creek Trail up-valley and continue to Holden Pass, the saddle between Bonanza and Martin Peaks, to reach the base of the west ridge.

waypoints.name: Railroad Creek Trailhead (Holden Campground)
waypoints.directions: There is no road to this trailhead. Take the Lake Chelan ferry from Chelan or Field's Point Landing up-lake to Lucerne Landing, then ride the Holden Village bus 11 miles up the gravel road into Holden Village, where the Railroad Creek Trail starts. Reserve the ferry ahead and confirm both the ferry and the bus are running before you plan the trip. A free self-issue Glacier Peak Wilderness permit is required.

waypoints.name: Martin Peak Summit
waypoints.directions: Follow Railroad Creek Trail #1256 about a mile up-valley to the fork, then take the Holden Lake Trail about four miles and 1,700 ft up to Holden Lake. Above the lake a climbers' path gains about 1,100 ft over heather benches to Holden Pass near 6,400 ft, the saddle between Bonanza and Martin. Go east straight up the ridge out of the pass, linking gullies on the right (south) side of the crest by cairns, to a steep Class 4 gully just below the summit.
